# shopify_product (Data Source)

Reads a product by the SKU of one of its variants, for example to reference products that Terraform doesn't manage in a collection's `product_ids`. Product GIDs differ per shop, the SKU doesn't, so the same configuration finds the matching product in each shop. Fails if no variant has the SKU, and if several variants share it (listing them), even within one product. Shopify's search index lags edits by a few seconds, so a SKU changed just before the read may not be found yet. Needs the `read_products` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Product GIDs differ per shop; the SKU finds the same product in each.
data "shopify_product" "bettschutz" {
  sku = "BS-100"
}

resource "shopify_collection" "bestselling" {
  title       = "Bestselling"
  handle      = "bestselling"
  product_ids = [data.shopify_product.bettschutz.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sku` (String) SKU of a variant of the product. Matched exactly, including case.

### Read-Only

- `handle` (String) Handle of the product.
- `id` (String) Product GID.
- `title` (String) Title of the product.
- `variant_id` (String) GID of the variant with the SKU.
